text: Stokes' theorem relates the surface integral of curl F over an oriented surface S to:
choices: the line integral of F around the boundary curve of S
the volume integral of div F over the region enclosed by S
the flux of F itself through S
the line integral of curl F around the boundary of S
explanation: Stokes' theorem states that the flux of curl F through S equals the circulation of F around the boundary curve: integral over S of (curl F . dS) = integral around boundary of (F . dr). The volume-integral statement is instead the Divergence Theorem.
